newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 3.75-4.25 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 3.75-4.25 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were again steady in a narrow 3.75-4.25 percent range on Wednesday with reluctant borrowers in a market awash with funds, dealers said.
"Demand was not as expected...everybody was covered easily," one dealer said.
Dealers say maturing CDs (Certificates of Deposit), a number of CD repos by banks and injection of dinar funds into the banking system have depressed rates recently.
